Weakness Description: Recurring account reviews are inconsistent and inactive accounts may remain enabled
Planned Remediation: Perform quarterly account reviews and automate termination access removal
Milestones: Create account inventory; define quarterly review schedule; automate offboarding; validate inactive accounts
Validation Evidence: Account review report and disablement logs
Closure Criteria: No unnecessary inactive accounts remain and quarterly review evidence is complete

Weakness Description: Privileged access reviews are incomplete and some users may retain excessive permissions
Planned Remediation: Perform quarterly privileged-access reviews and enforce least privilege
Milestones: Inventory privileged accounts; document business justification; review permissions; remove unnecessary access
Validation Evidence: Privileged access inventory and review approvals
Closure Criteria: All privileged accounts have current justification and unnecessary access is removed

Weakness Description: Recurring audit-log reviews are not consistently documented
Planned Remediation: Establish recurring security log review procedures and retain evidence
Milestones: Define review frequency; assign reviewers; document investigations; retain escalation records
Validation Evidence: Log review records and incident tickets
Closure Criteria: Recurring log reviews are documented and exceptions are investigated

Weakness Description: Configuration baselines are not formally reviewed on a consistent schedule
Planned Remediation: Review and approve secure configuration baselines annually
Milestones: Inventory baselines; compare to current standards; update configurations; obtain approval
Validation Evidence: Approved baseline standards and review records
Closure Criteria: Current baselines are approved and review dates are documented

Weakness Description: Configuration exceptions are not centrally tracked
Milestones: Create exception register; assign owners; define due dates; track remediation
Closure Criteria: All active exceptions have owners due dates and documented disposition

Planned Remediation: Conduct quarterly restoration testing and document results
Milestones: Select critical systems; perform restore tests; record recovery times; remediate failed tests
Validation Evidence: Restore test reports and recovery logs
Closure Criteria: Quarterly restore tests are completed and critical systems are successfully recovered

Weakness Description: MFA is not enforced for all privileged accounts
Planned Remediation: Require MFA for all privileged accounts
Milestones: Identify privileged accounts; enable MFA; document exceptions; verify enrollment
Validation Evidence: MFA configuration and privileged account inventory
Closure Criteria: 100 percent of applicable privileged accounts are protected by MFA or have approved exceptions

Weakness Description: MFA coverage for applicable remote users is not fully validated
Planned Remediation: Review and enforce MFA coverage for remote access
Milestones: Inventory remote users; compare MFA enrollment; remediate gaps; document exceptions
Validation Evidence: MFA coverage report and authentication settings
Closure Criteria: All applicable remote users are enrolled in MFA or have approved exceptions

Weakness Description: Incident response procedures are not regularly tested
Planned Remediation: Conduct annual incident response tabletop exercise
Milestones: Develop scenario; identify participants; conduct exercise; document lessons learned; assign corrective actions
Validation Evidence: Tabletop exercise report and corrective-action tracker
Closure Criteria: Exercise is completed and identified corrective actions are assigned

Weakness Description: High-risk vulnerabilities exceed target remediation timelines
Milestones: Define SLA targets; review aging vulnerabilities; remediate overdue findings; document risk acceptance
Validation Evidence: Vulnerability aging report and remediation tickets
Closure Criteria: High-risk vulnerabilities meet SLA or have formally approved risk acceptance

Weakness Description: High-risk suppliers are not consistently reassessed
Planned Remediation: Perform annual reassessments of high-risk suppliers
Milestones: Classify suppliers; schedule reassessments; issue questionnaires; review evidence; track findings
Validation Evidence: Supplier assessment reports and remediation records
Closure Criteria: All high-risk suppliers have current assessments and open findings are tracked

Weakness Description: Risk assessment evidence is fragmented across multiple locations
Planned Remediation: Centralize risk assessment evidence and management review records
Milestones: Create evidence repository; migrate current records; define naming standards; assign owners
Validation Evidence: Risk assessment repository and evidence index
Closure Criteria: Risk assessment evidence is centrally stored and retrievable
